purpose: Test role-specific daily information beyond simple price-volume controls; not a complete strategy or account-return claim.
data_access: Pinned public DFLS fetch in the S014 context only; no new source calls.

features.information_interpretation: All features are transformations of the same daily source. Any increment is representational, not an independent information source.
features.availability: Features use bars through completed T only. First 20 sessions warm up inside the permitted interval. No external pre-window data.

labels.entry: Each T independently plans a 100000-CNY full-cash 1% premium limit order with the existing SRT execution planner for T+1. TXE resolves daily range execution.
labels.exit: MARKET at the open H tradable sessions after entry; a lower-limit opening requires open plus one tick. If unreachable, retry the next tradable session until cutoff.
labels.return: Net cash profit divided by 100000 after both fees and actual planned lot quantity. Unfilled attempts have zero realized profit and explicit entry_filled=false.
labels.risk: Entry-relative worst close/exit-price decline during the holding interval; excludes intraday lows with unknown before/after-fill ordering. Not account maximum drawdown.
labels.censoring: Exclude attempts whose common planned horizon or actual delayed exit is outside cutoff. Do not force terminal liquidation.
labels.maturity: Training labels must mature strictly before the first test signal date.
labels.scope_limit: Overlapping independent trade attempts cannot be compounded or interpreted as a single-position account.

design.training: Expanding history from 2020; train only on labels fully mature before the test year. 2026 is partial through the fixed cutoff.
design.preprocessing: Train-only mean imputation and standardization. No future fit or cross-year resampling of model selection.
design.estimator: Fixed linear ridge with intercept, penalty 10; same estimator for baseline and augmented features. No hyperparameter or strategy-parameter search.
design.selection: Fix the 75th percentile of training predictions for return selection and the 25th percentile for adverse-movement selection, then apply unchanged to the following test year. Compare identical eligible test dates, report different actual selection fractions and do not use future-year score quantiles.
design.negative_control: Also report unconditional attempt outcomes, fill rates and filled-only adverse movement to distinguish useful information from simply avoiding fills.
design.uncertainty: 5000 paired circular moving-block bootstrap draws, block length 20, resampled separately within test years. Compare contributions normalized by each fixed model's actual test selection fraction, weighted by eligible dates; these fractions normalize retrospective statistics only, never determine the trading signal. Missing selections remain unavailable.
design.multiple_comparisons: 12 comparisons (3 families times 4 horizons): report ordinary 95% and Bonferroni 1-0.05/12 intervals. These are development diagnostics, not future-success probabilities.
design.component_judgment: Describe signs by year, pooled difference, strongest contrary evidence, filled-only risk and representational redundancy; no economic acceptance gate is added. Weak or mixed findings are not declared Alpha.

precheck: Synthetic serial/spawn results and prefix-causal feature equivalence before formal computation; verify tsfresh columns and transport.
boundaries: No S013 or other batch data
No phase-three advance without user approval
